protocol.method: Finite-horizon fitted Q-learning with linear ridge regressions on sampled public transitions
protocol.primary: Released Q policy minus the unchanged posted-distribution planner, mean net credits per shift
protocol.secondary: Released Q policy minus history-adjusted planner and frozen Reserve v1 Q policy
protocol.selection: Evaluate all five final fits. Release the first seed irrespective of its validation or test score.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired percentile interval over scenario seeds with patterns kept together, conditional on the released fit
